newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Acer develops digital TV set-top box.
newsitem.headline: Acer develops digital TV set-top box.

text.p: Taiwan computer giant Acer Inc said on Wednesday it has developed a complete digital satellite television receiver, saying it was the first Taiwan firm to launch such a set-top box.
Acer said in a statement it would cooperate with Space TV Systems to offer Chinese programes at no charge over a satellite to Chinese communities around the world.
Space TV, a programme provider, is 60 percent owned by Taiwan investors, with the remainder held by U.S.-based Oriental Telemedia Corp and Mercury Capital Partner Inc, Acer said.
Acer chairman Stan Shih said the set-top box called ACERSTAR is a multi-use home digital product. Its functions are dubbed "three C" for computer, communication and consumer electronics.
"By the turn of the century...every household will own such a multi-purpose information technology household product," Shih was quoted as saying.
ACERSTAR would be combined with an Internet appliance to enable households simultaneously to surf the Internet and watch direct satellite programming, Acer said.
Acer is working with several service providers in the United States, Japan and Europe to provide them with ACERSTAR on an original equipment manufacturing basis, it said.
